goal: Fly a PX4 quadrotor from take-off to a GPS goal and land there, avoiding obstacles seen by the forward depth camera (Gazebo depth camera in SITL, Orbbec Gemini 336L on the real drone).
main_node_summary: 3DVFH+ (vfh3d.py) in PX4 OFFBOARD, velocity setpoints over uXRCE-DDS (same code in SITL and on the Orin; named obstacle_avoidance_static_gps until 2026-11-16, which now flies Position mode), FlightLogger output (flight.csv, vfh.npz, plots).

criteria_notes.goal_radius_m: final horizontal distance to the goal (dist_goal column); equals ACCEPT_RADIUS of the main node
criteria_notes.must_land: the flight must end disarmed after having flown (max height >= 1 m)
criteria_notes.min_clearance_m: minimum of nearest_all (else nearest_ahead) while airborne in the hover/cruise phases; VFH3D keeps safety_radius = 1.5 m
criteria_notes.max_airborne_s: time between the first and last airborne row; the forest route is about 52 m at MAX_SPEED 0.5 m/s (0.3 until 2026-11-15)
criteria_notes.forbidden_nav_states: PX4 1.14 nav_state values that mean a failsafe: 5 AUTO_RTL, 12 DESCEND, 13 TERMINATION
criteria_notes.crash_descent_mps: vd (down positive) faster than this outside the landing/stopping phases counts as a fall
criteria_notes.crash_speed_mps: any speed above this counts as a crash or a tumble (the main node flies at up to 0.5 m/s)
criteria_notes.disarm_in_air_height_m: disarming while higher than this counts as a crash

acceptance.stage_1_sitl: my_forest world, goal worlds/forest_goal.json, main node: 3 PASS flights in a row
acceptance.stage_2_sitl_moving: same world plus worlds/moving_obstacle.py crossing the route: 3 PASS flights in a row
acceptance.stage_3_real: real drone over open ground with one obstacle, PASS with a pilot ready on the radio
